aboutus.banner.desc: Fa yɛn kapet a ɛyɛ fɛ no sesa wo tenabea, baabi a ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ nneɛma ne ahotɔ di nkitaho wɔ nhama biara mu.
aboutus.desc: Yɛma wo akwaaba ba Al-Barkaat Overseas, baabi a atetesɛm hyia nneɛma foforo wɔ wiase a wɔde kata fam a ɛyɛ fɛ mu. Yɛn anigye a yɛwɔ wɔ rugs ho no agye ntini kɛse wɔ fiber biara mu, na yɛde hoahoa yɛn ho kɛse sɛ yɛde rugs pa ahorow a wɔayɛ no yiye a ɛyɛ ahonyade, ahotɔ, ne amammerɛ mu ahonyade ho mfonini bɛma mo. Sɛ́ ebia wohwehwɛ sɛ wode atetesɛm mu hyew bɛhyɛ w’ahunmu, nnɛyi adwini a ɛtwetwe adwene, anaasɛ abien no nyinaa a wɔde afrafra a ɛne ne ho hyia no, wɔayɛ yɛn ntama no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛboro nneɛma a wɔde siesie hɔ ara kwa so na abɛyɛ agyapade a w’ani gye ho wɔ wo fie anaa w’adwumayɛbea mu. Fa anammɔn kɔ ahemman bi a nsaanodwuma ne agyapade hyia, baabi a nsusuwii ahorow a bere ntumi nsɛe no ne nnέyi nkate bom – hwehwɛ rug a ɛyɛ pέ a ƐbƐboa w’ankorankoro su na ama wo tenabea akɔ soro wɔ Al-Barkaat Overseas.
